title: Terms of Enrolment onto an Employee Meal Account
content:
These are the conditions on which Larkspur Table Workplace Dining Group opens and activates an Employee Meal Account for an employee, and on which the badge that taps it is issued and replaced.

**1. The plan an employee is enrolled onto.** An employee is enrolled onto the highest meal plan whose entry gate they meet on length of service, on whether their employer runs the programme, on whether payroll consent has been given and on whether a manager has approved.

**2. The state the account must stand in.** An account is only opened or activated while it stands enrolled or already active, and an enrolment cancelled before the badge is ever used closes without charge. This is read off the account's own record before the account is opened or activated, by the account's reference, and it is the record that governs rather than what the employee reports; the only states that satisfy it are enrolled and active.

**3. When the enrolment charge falls.** The enrolment charge printed against the plan is raised on the account at activation and never at enrolment, so an enrolment that is cancelled costs the employee nothing.

**4. Payroll consent.** Plans that require payroll consent are not activated until that consent is recorded, and until then the account stays enrolled and the badge is declined at the till.

**5. Falling short on length of service.** Where the employee does not meet the length of service printed against the plan asked for, the account is opened on the highest plan whose service requirement they do meet, and the employee is told when they will qualify.

**6. The badge.** The badge registered on the account is the badge the employer issued; a replacement badge carries the replacement charge printed against the plan and the account is frozen for the freeze hours printed against the same plan from the moment a loss is reported.

## Positive and negative cases

| The situation | The result under these terms |
|---|---|
| The account stands enrolled and payroll consent has been recorded on a plan that requires it | The account is activated and the plan's enrolment charge is raised |
| The account stands enrolled on a plan requiring payroll consent, with no consent recorded | The account stays enrolled and the badge is declined at the till |
| The enrolment is cancelled before the badge has ever been used | The account closes without charge and no enrolment charge falls |
| The employee asks for a plan whose printed service requirement they have not served | The account is opened on the highest plan whose service requirement they do meet |
| The account stands closed | It is neither opened nor activated, the state condition being unmet |
